receipt.intro: Tick each item as actually received. Unticked items are recorded as Not Received for supplier follow-up. Enter the manufacturer physical validity (one date for all pieces of the item) and verifiable evidence (label/packaging/invoice; use 📷 to read by camera). Use "Split into lots" when there are different validities or individual exceptions. Pieces without proven validity enter BLOCKED (unknown) and must be regularised later in Validity & Blocks.
